name: gerrymander_metrics
description: Measure a districting plan: wasted votes and the efficiency gap from two-party district votes, the mean-median difference and seats against votes, and Polsby-Popper and Reock compactness from district polygons in planar coordinates. Vote metrics are exact fractions.

votes.description: Two-party votes, the same two parties in every district

polygon.description: Outline as [x, y] points in planar (projected) coordinates

parts.description: Several outlines for a district in pieces (no holes)

parties.description: The two parties; the first is the reference for signed figures. Default the order of the first district's votes

winner_threshold.description: Winner's wasted votes: above half the district's votes (Stephanopoulos & McGhee) or above floor(total/2)+1

catalog.source: original; Stephanopoulos & McGhee, Partisan Gerrymandering and the Efficiency Gap, U. Chicago Law Review 82 (2015); Polsby & Popper, Yale Law & Policy Review 9 (1991); Reock, Midwest Journal of Political Science 5 (1961); checked against Wikipedia's Efficiency gap sample calculation
